"""
Canvas Grader GUI
=================
GUI version of canvas_rubric_grader.py.

Login:
  No API token needed. Click “Browser Login” to open a Chrome window and log in to
  Canvas manually (CWL / Duo). The script then reuses that login session (session
  cookie + CSRF token) to call the Canvas API, with exactly the same permissions as
  when you work in the web UI / SpeedGrader.
  - The script never sees your password; the session is kept in memory only and ends when the app closes
  - The browser uses a separate profile (~/.canvas_grader/browser-profile) and does not affect your normal Chrome
  - When the session expires, just click “Browser Login” again

Features:
  1. Log in to Canvas via the browser
  2. Enter an Assignment ID, fetch the assignment info and rubric
  3. Generate a grades.csv template (one row per student, filterable by Lab)
  4. Download submissions -> pack into submissions.zip -> extract into the workspace by Lab/student. Every submission type is supported:
     file uploads, text entries (including pasted images), URLs, media recordings, discussions, annotation assignments,
     Classic Quizzes and New Quizzes (each student's answers are exported to quiz_answers.html / .md; uploaded files go to quiz_files/)
  5. After filling in grades.csv, bulk-submit rubric scores to Canvas (dry run first if you like)

Workspace layout:
  <workspace>/
    rubric.json          assignment + rubric definition (read when submitting grades)
    grades.csv           grade sheet (student_id = Canvas user ID)
    manifest.csv         submission list (submitted at / late / files / folder)
    submissions.zip      all original submission files (Canvas "Download Submissions" naming)
    quiz_questions.md    (Quiz) questions + correct answers
    quiz_responses.csv   (Quiz) every student's answers side by side, one column per question, for grading question by question
    L08/
      Last_First_2539745/
        _original/       original files uploaded by the student
        ...              auto-extracted contents
        quiz_answers.html / .md        (Quiz) this student's answers; earlier attempts are quiz_attempt<N>.*
        submission_text.html / .txt    (text entry) images are saved in submission_text_files/
        SpeedGrader.url                opens this student in SpeedGrader

grades.csv format (compatible with canvas_rubric_grader.py; extra columns are ignored):
  student_id, student_name, student_number, section, status,
  _1953, _1953_comment, _8704, _8704_comment, ..., comment
  - Blank score = criterion not graded; whole row blank = student skipped
  - Rows whose student_id starts with "#" (the rubric legend in row 2) are not submitted
  - If the assignment has no rubric, the score column gives the total score directly

Run: python3 canvas_grader_gui.py
Requires: pip install requests playwright  (uses the locally installed Google Chrome;
      without Chrome, also run playwright install chromium); tkinter ships with Python
"""
